tagline: A growing outer Asian side district at the edge of Istanbul's forested outskirts — newer residential developments, good schools, and access to the Belgrade Forest belt.

items.name: Çekmeköy Orman Alanları
items.description: The district borders significant forested areas on the Asian outskirts — popular with locals for weekend hikes and picnics.

items.name: Çekmeköy Meydanı
items.description: The central square of the district hosts a weekly market and is the social hub for residents.

items.name: Merkez Kafeler
items.description: A growing number of café options around the town centre, serving the district's young residential population.

items.name: Semt Restoranları
items.description: Neighbourhood restaurants and lokantas serving straightforward Turkish cuisine at local prices.

tips: The M5 metro line connects Çekmeköy to Üsküdar in around 30 minutes.
Popular with families seeking more space and greener surroundings than inner Istanbul.
The area is developing fast — infrastructure is improving year by year.
Best suited to longer-term residents; not a destination for short visits.
